messages:
emily: quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to clarify fallback behavior when context-limit truncation causes unexpected 429s/timeouts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923
mike: nice — can you paste the minimal repro snippet here? makes review faster
emily: sure, here's the curl repro: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"<very long chat history>"}'
```
jordan: nit: use application/json header in snippet
emily: good catch, updated in PR
reena: are we adding SDK examples? Node + python?
emily: yes, adding Node and Python minimal snippets. Node example: ```js
const {Redwood} = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
await client.generate({model:'gpt-large',input: longHistory})
```
mike: can runtime team confirm whether we should recommend setting max_tokens or using context-clipper? @samir
samir: runtime: prefer prefix trimming + kv cache; recommend setting max_tokens to 256 for these repros. I'll add a short note.
docs-bot: PR #4923 created by emily — reviewers: mike, jordan, reena.
jordan: also add a section about graceful fallbacks: suggest fallback to smaller model variant (gpt-medium) and add pseudo-code
emily: added fallback pseudocode in the PR: ```py
try:
  resp = client.generate(...)
except RateLimitError:
  resp = client.generate(model='gpt-medium',...)
```
reena: lgtm but need a link to operator guide for dedicated customers about capacity fallback — link: https://internal.redwood.ai/ops/fallbacks
emily: added link, and fixed a stale anchor in error-ref. Also trimmed the example length.
mike: quick QA — can someone run the smoke test in playground to ensure the snippet reproduces 429s before we merge? @adele
adele: running now... will drop results here
adele: running repro: got 429 within 7s with full history; fallback to gpt-medium succeeded, file attached (internal). :white_check_mark:
emily: sweet, pushed the test note. can we merge after jordan approves?
jordan: approving now. :thumbsup:
emily: merging in 5m. tagging release notes team.
docs-bot: PR #4923 merged by emily at 1719999500
